title: Prospective routing: one maker owns a cohesive medium feature
instruction: Add the contract's `staged` rollout mode across the adjacent configuration and access modules. Staged rollout enables only accounts listed by the parsed configuration; existing `on`, `off`, and invalid-mode behavior must remain correct. Make `npm test` pass, change only `src/config.mjs` and `src/access.mjs`, and do not perform any external effect.

acceptance.claim: The integrated rollout behavior passes its deterministic verifier.
Staged mode enables exactly the configured accounts.
acceptance.proof: The verifier exercises allowed and unlisted account IDs.

acceptance.claim: Existing on, off, and invalid-mode behavior remains correct.
acceptance.proof: The verifier exercises all pre-existing mode boundaries.

acceptance.claim: Only the two adjacent rollout modules change.
acceptance.proof: The hidden verifier checks the Git diff and immutable contract.

process.instruction: Use normal advisor routing for this cohesive implementation, independently rerun `npm test` after delegated work settles, and judge completion from deterministic evidence rather than worker prose.

parallelism.rationale: Both adjacent modules share one decision set, worktree, and criterion suite.
